tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Company received a GST audit notice under Section 65 of the Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 for FY 2022-23. On August 17, 2026, audit observations proposed a demand of INR 2,50,40,177/-: INR 2,48,94,324/- on exempt turnover and INR 1,45,853/- on the GSTR-3B vs GSTR-2B mismatch. Based on the Company’s response, the final audit report dated September 9, 2026, dropped the INR 2,48,94,324/- demand on hostel services to TAPMI students, but proposed reversal of common ITC under Rule 42 and retained the GSTR-2B observation. A DRC-01 dated September 28, 2026, was then issued, proposing a demand of INR 35,88,558/- (tax, interest and penalty) on both issues.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Assistant Commissioner of Commercial Taxes (Audit)-4.8, DGSTO-4, Bangalore
tax_litigation.status: The Company is in the process of submitting its response and is taking appropriate steps in accordance with applicable law.
